services:
  nginx:
    image: nginx:alpine
    ports: ["80:80", "443:443"]
    volumes:
      - ./nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
      - ./certbot/www:/var/www/certbot:ro
      - ./certbot/conf:/etc/letsencrypt:ro

  certbot:
    image: certbot/certbot
    volumes:
      - ./certbot/www:/var/www/certbot
      - ./certbot/conf:/etc/letsencrypt
    command: certonly --webroot -w /var/www/certbot -d {{domain}} --email {{email}} --agree-tos --non-interactive
summary_zh: compose nginx + certbot 自動 SSL
